create_KukaGymEnv: create a KukaGymEnv instance with configurable action repeat, rendering mode, and discrete or continuous action space
reset_KukaGymEnv: reset the KukaGymEnv simulation by reloading the plane, table, block, and Kuka robot URDFs
step_KukaGymEnv: step the KukaGymEnv environment forward by applying a discrete or continuous action to the robot gripper
render_KukaGymEnv: render the KukaGymEnv simulation as an RGB array image using the PyBullet OpenGL camera
getExtendedObservation_KukaGymEnv: get the extended observation including gripper state, block position, and block orientation in gripper space
